tasks.title: Record every execution Session focus, including Terminal
tasks.objective: Make real Region and Tab focus update the existing execution focus lane while preserving PMO isolation.
tasks.outcome: Clicking or keyboard-focusing an Agent or Terminal Region makes that Session the current execution focus and adds it to the bounded MRU history; PMO focus never writes execution history.
acceptance: focusRegion and the direct Session selection paths record Agent and Terminal Sessions through one typed execution focus path.
PMO Session focus continues to update only the PMO lane.
A focused Store test proves a Terminal Session enters history and a mutation that removes the record call turns the test red.
Zero-caller grep shows the focus recording path is used outside its defining module.

verification.ref: pnpm --filter @agentmux/desktop exec vitest run test/agent-focus-context.test.ts test/pmo-focus-isolation.test.ts test/focus-history-terminal.test.ts --maxWorkers=1

tasks.title: Rename Agents surface to Focus and expose a left history list
tasks.objective: Productize execution focus as a first-class Focus surface with a reusable history list that includes Agent and Terminal Sessions.
tasks.outcome: The surface switch, breadcrumb, accessible names, and main panel say Focus; the left history list is clickable and selects the matching Session without duplicating PMO context.
acceptance: Focus history is a left-side list, not a top summary rail, and each Agent or Terminal entry has a clear selected state.
Terminal entries use a terminal identity icon and do not render an empty Agent avatar slot.
Clicking a history entry selects the same execution Session used by Workspaces and Board.
Component tests assert the left history structure and terminal entry; removing the click handler makes the test red.

verification.ref: pnpm --filter @agentmux/desktop exec vitest run test/global-focus-surface.test.tsx test/global-agents-board.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1

tasks.heavy_reason: The surface name, reusable list component, terminal identity projection, and existing observation panel must remain one coherent navigation surface.

tasks.title: Apply modern Focus layout and prove durable continuity
tasks.objective: Tune the three-column Focus layout and keep cross-surface/restart projections on the durable focus context.
tasks.outcome: Focus reads as a modern workspace, remains usable at narrow widths, and the current Session/history survive the existing persistence and recovery probes.
acceptance: Left history, status groups, and observation surface use the documented density language without adding a second card or history store.
Cross-surface navigation and recovery tests continue to resolve the same execution Session.
The source and installed candidate are clean and the focused regression suite passes.

verification.ref: pnpm --filter @agentmux/desktop exec vitest run test/session-context-navigation.test.ts test/recovery-probe.test.ts test/agent-focus-context.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
